queue.claim: The mandibular condyle lies about 10-15 mm anterior to the tragus. The jaw rotates for the first 20-25 mm of incisal opening and then translates; normal maximum opening is about 40-55 mm.
queue.query: mandibular condyle distance anterior to tragus mm palpation TMJ rotation translation opening

queue.claim: The thyroid cartilage laminae meet at about 90 deg in men and about 120 deg in women. The laryngeal prominence sits at about C4-C5, about 1-2 cm below the hyoid, and rises about 1.5-3 cm on swallowing.
queue.query: thyroid cartilage laminae angle 90 degrees men 120 degrees women laryngeal prominence
